title: Sunshine activity holidays
titleCn: 阳光活动度假中心报名咨询

paragraphs.text: Good morning. Sunshine Activity Holidays. Can I help you?
Hi. I'm ringing from Boston in the USA. We're coming to the UK in the summer to visit my parents, and my children want to do an activity holiday at your center.
Of course. First of all, may I take down some details? Can I have your children's full names, please?
My son is David, David William Smith, and my daughter is Maria Fiona, with two Ns, Smith.
And your home address?
463 Beacon Street. That's B-E-A-C-O-N Street, Boston, MA 02116.
Thanks. And a home phone number?
Six one seven seven four two nine eight three five.
Our courses all start on a Saturday. Which week do your children want to come?
They need to do a course which begins on the 27th of June and finishes on the 14th of July.
So that's one week only. Okay. Now, have you got any particular activities in mind for them?
Well, last summer, the whole family went sailing, and they really enjoyed it. So I think it would be nice for them to do that again. You do that on a lake nearby, I think.
That's right.
And my daughter would like to try surfing.
That's a great choice. Would your son enjoy that, too?
He'd rather do rock climbing. He completed a two-day program last year, and he really enjoyed it.
I'll make a note of that. Good. Any other sports they'd like to try?
Horse riding is number one on Maria's list, as she rides here in the United States. And David is keen to have lessons, but he's a bit nervous. I think he needs to build his confidence.
Okay, I've got that. I take it the children can swim. We've got two pools at the center, and we also take them to the beach.
Yes, they both swim well. In fact, I saw on your website that children can do their swimming awards during their stay.
Well, actually, we're only offering the gold certificate this year. We didn't get much interest in the silver and platinum awards last year.
I think David would like to do that. I don't think Maria is ready yet.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.
That's fine. What about indoor activities? We offer quite a varied range.
Yes, I saw that. David's done a lot of drama, so he'd like to do that. Maria is a bit shy, but I think it would be good for her. Put her down for that, too.

Well, there are opportunities for everyone, whether they've done it before or not. So that's fine. Uh, we'll also be offering a new course which hasn't been advertised yet: cookery. That's to replace woodwork.
Well, Maria loves making cakes, so she'd enjoy that. And it'll be something different for David, so put them both down for that.
That's fine. Well, I'll get a copy of their program for the week sent to you as soon as possible.
Thank you. Oh, by the way, will they need to bring any sports equipment with them?

We provide all safety equipment, riding hats, life jackets, et cetera, free of charge, as well as things like surfboards and tennis rackets. But you can hire other equipment, like a wet suit, for a small fee.
Mm. She does have her own, but I don't think there'll be room in her luggage, so we better hire one.
Fine.
Oh, there's just one other thing I need to check with you.
My husband and I won't be traveling to the UK with the children. We arrive a week later, so they'll need to be met at the airport.
I would ask my parents to meet them, but the flight gets in really early, at 6:30, and they live a long way from the airport.

So we'll need to book the transfer for 7:00. It'll take them at least half an hour to get through immigration. We'll have a representative waiting in arrivals. Now, you'll need to send us a deposit of-
